Use independent sufficient and latent graph fixtures with the exact CI-test/sampling assumptions; alpha is not whole-graph confidence.
Record effect on graph alternatives when depth/path/max_k truncation is used.
Qualify each missingness correction and dependency environment separately before supporting incomplete bank panels.

identity_evidence.anchor: Saved commit identity; not a capability claim

supported_claims: NetworkTMLE documents expected incidence under a treatment plan with Monte Carlo averaging for stochastic allocations and direct-contact interference.
The constructor rejects noninteger node identities, self-loops and nonbinary exposure, remaps identities and builds an unweighted adjacency matrix.
The documentation disclaims a missing-data procedure, describes degree restrictions and gives a directed influence convention opposite the graph arrow.
limits: Documentation describes an undirected input while also giving a directed convention; the selected constructor contains directed handling. Directed semantics need explicit runtime review.
Arbitrary contagion, weighted/dynamic networks, missing ownership and variance validity are not established.

decision.bank_case: Borrower-group outreach with immediate-neighbor spillovers, where relationship direction and exposure are owned definitions.

The concentration design is prospective and conditional; audit allocations optimize only the stated worst-case variance criterion.
